items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: Not with us, anyway, if he went along there.

ctx.x: We got the third reel on now, Rene Netto.
I missed all that now. Did Rene Jalpe ever play guitar?
To my knowledge, no. I don't think Rene would play guitar. Not with us, anyway, if he went along there. But you said that they had two.
